- [ ] Recommended sections present, in order (see `docs/skill-anatomy.md`).
- [ ] Every rule or step states where it applies and where it does not.
- [ ] Written entirely in English.
- [ ] File sizes respect the limits in `docs/skill-anatomy.md`.
- [ ] Skills board and Contributors sections left untouched (they are generated).
- [ ] For automation changes: `python scripts/update-readme.py --check` passes.
